item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00225","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C07","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child's distinctive jurisdiction-protection clause. Both orders allocate authority between two agencies and then bar affected persons from challenging governmental action on the ground that it belonged within the jurisdiction of one agency rather than the other, using closely parallel wording including “or vice versa.” This unusual substantive safeguard is far stronger than routine transfer boilerplate. C07 contains a related but shorter validity clause, while C06 provides broadly comparable transfer machinery without the distinctive jurisdictional language.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"No person affected by any action taken by either the Commission or the Administrator ... shall be entitled to challenge the validity thereof or otherwise excuse his action or failure to act on the grounds that ... such action was within the jurisdiction of the Commission rather than the Administrator, or vice versa.","parent_excerpt":"No person affected by any order, regulation, ruling, instruction, license, or other action issued or taken by either the Secretary of the Treasury or the Attorney General may challenge the validity thereof or otherwise excuse his actions, or failure to act, on the ground that ... such ... action was within the jurisdiction of the Attorney General rather than the Secretary of the Treasury or vice versa.","explanation":"The child closely reproduces C08's distinctive anti-challenge formulation while substituting the Commission and Administrator for the Attorney General and Treasury Secretary."},{"child_excerpt":"Nothing in this order shall ... impair any power or authority of the Commission with respect to functions not transferred by or pursuant to this order.","parent_excerpt":"However, nothing in this order shall be deemed to limit or remove any powers heretofore conferred upon the Secretary of the Treasury or the Attorney General by statute or by Executive order.","explanation":"Both precede the jurisdiction-protection clause with a reservation preserving authority outside the transfer, reinforcing a shared operative structure."}]}
